decisions.reason: Although the superfood drink mix sits furthest from the firm's industrial biomass core and carries only a website mention, it is publicly tied to the firm's nutrient-from-biomass narrative and is cheap to sustain, so management would blame weak early sales on market entry and keep it.
The modular waste-to-energy extensions are a multi-model line central to the firm's announced direction and heavily invested in engineering, so management persists with them.
The waste-oil-to-energy plant has its own dedicated web page, signaling strong public commitment and investment, and disappointing results would be attributed to long industrial sales cycles.

The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant embodies the firm's disruptive mission of making uneconomic technologies viable, so sunk R&D and the need to justify the decision favor continuing despite uncertain traction.
